title: Domain Registrations Refund Windows and Destinations
content:
# Domain Registrations — Refund Windows and Destinations

Billing desk reference table. A refund window is a number of calendar days after the charge date of the original charge; a window of 0 means that charge type is never refunded on that TLD product.

| TLD product | New registration (deleted for a full refund) | Manual or grace-period renewal | Auto-renew charge | Restore charge refundable | Inbound transfer charge refunded in full when the transfer is cancelled |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| .us Domain Registration | 5 days | 5 days | 30 days | No | Yes |
| .ca Domain Registration | 0 (never) | 0 (never) | 0 (never) | No | Yes |
| .com Domain Registration | 5 days | 5 days | 30 days | No | Yes |
| .org Domain Registration | 5 days | 5 days | 30 days | No | Yes |
| .net Domain Registration | 5 days | 5 days | 30 days | No | Yes |
| .co Domain Registration | 0 (never) | 0 (never) | 0 (never) | No | Yes |
| .io Domain Registration | 0 (never) | 0 (never) | 0 (never) | No | Yes |

## Where a refund goes

| TLD product | Destination when the customer states no preference | Customer may elect account credit for a card or PayPal charge |
|---|---|---|
| .us Domain Registration | The original payment method | Yes |
| .ca Domain Registration | The original payment method | Yes |
| .com Domain Registration | The original payment method | Yes |
| .org Domain Registration | The original payment method | Yes |
| .net Domain Registration | The original payment method | Yes |
| .co Domain Registration | The original payment method | Yes |
| .io Domain Registration | The original payment method | Yes |

## Hypothetical windows

A hypothetical auto-renew charge on a .net Domain Registration dated 2 March 2029 falls inside its 30-day window through 1 April 2029, the 30th day after the charge date. The same charge type on a .co Domain Registration has a window of 0 and is never refunded.
